# Draft:Color Battles

----
Color Battles
Color Battles is a small scratch animation series created by a user called KawaiiBobs, the series has a sister show (color cartoons). Color battles has a total of 6 episodes as of now with 7 most likely coming soon. Color cartoons has 4 episodes as of now. TBFTSC and MDTSI5M has not started. KawaiiBobs joined Scratch on the 19th of October 2024 starting off as a suggestion account for KawaiiBlobs until KawaiiBlobs would get hacked. After that, KawaiiBobs started becoming more independant, working on a game called duck herding simulator where he would share a project called movement test creating Movement Test Dummy (Keep the name in your head it is REALLY important). Then a Month after he stopped the development of Duck Herding Simulator and then one day, they thought of a show where tons of colors would fight, but they didn't know HOW to make them, then they remember... MOVEMENT TEST DUMMY, with that, the original style was created! But as of Color Battles 3, they would change it into a drawn style but as of episode 4, he changed it where only the limbs were drawn and thats how the style they use now was born!

And KawaiiBobs.
Black, White, Violet and KawaiiBobs all share a power where all 4 of them can hear the user KawaiiBobs but KawaiiBobs is the only one of the 4 that DOES NOT have a second power, the rest are gods (White for life, Black for destruction and Violet for Sustainability).
The show is confirmed to have a Second Season (adding 14 new colors with Black and KawaiiBobs joining the fight. increasing the roster to a great 24 instead of 8)
An Object Show calles TBFTSC (The Battle For The Spectrum's Control) is on the way and will most likely start after season 1 and before season 2 of Color Battles. Another show that is about to starts is MDTSI5M (My Disney Trip Shortened Into 5 Minutes) Where KawaiiBobs talks about their trip to Disneyland Paris.
There is already TONS of lore, without the first lore episode (CONFIRMED TO BE SEASON 1 EPISODE 7)!
